passages.title: Quote for office chairs
lines: Dear Ms. Carter,
Thank you for visiting our showroom last Tuesday. As you requested, here is our price for the Model 7 office chair.
The standard price is $120 per chair. For orders of fifty chairs or more, we can offer a 10% discount, so the price would be $108 per chair. This price is good until the end of May.

We have sixty chairs in stock right now, and we can deliver them within ten days. If you need more than sixty, the additional chairs will take about four weeks, because they are made by our manufacturer in Vietnam.
I have also enclosed a brochure for our new desks. Please let me know if you would like any samples.
Best regards, Luis Park (Nova Office Supply)

questions.en: Why did Mr. Park write to Ms. Carter?
questions.zh: Park 先生為什麼寫信給 Carter 小姐？
options: To give her the information she asked for
To invite her to visit a showroom
To announce a new line of desks
To confirm the date of a delivery

questions.en: How much would each chair cost in an order of fifty?
questions.zh: 如果訂五十張，每張椅子多少錢？

questions.en: What is suggested about an order of eighty chairs?
questions.zh: 關於訂八十張椅子，文中暗示了什麼？
options: It would not get a discount.
All of the chairs would come from Vietnam.
It would have to be paid for by the end of May.
Some of the chairs would arrive later than the others.

passages.title: Harbor View Hotel: Pool closed
lines: Dear Guests,
From June 3 to June 14, the swimming pool on the second floor will be closed while we install new lights and air conditioners. We apologize for any inconvenience.

During this period, the gym will be open from 6 a.m. to 11 p.m., as it normally is. Guests may also use the pool at our other hotel nearby, the Lakeside Inn, at no charge. A free shuttle leaves our front entrance every hour from 8 a.m. to 8 p.m. Please show your room key to the driver.
Breakfast hours will not change. If you have any questions, please speak to a member of staff at the reception desk.

questions.en: Why will the pool be closed?
questions.zh: 游泳池為什麼會關閉？
options: It is being moved to the second floor.
A shuttle service is starting.
New equipment is being put in.
The Lakeside Inn is using it.

questions.en: What is most likely true about people who ride the shuttle?
questions.zh: 關於搭接駁車的人，下列何者最可能正確？
options: They must be staying at the Harbor View Hotel.
They must pay the driver in cash.
They must book a seat at the reception desk.
They must leave before 8 a.m.

questions.en: Who should guests talk to if they have a question?
questions.zh: 房客有問題時應該找誰？
options: The shuttle driver
An employee at the front desk
The manager of the Lakeside Inn
A worker at the gym

passages.title: Ms. Carter (11:40 a.m.)
lines: Hi Nina, I'm still at the airport. My flight to Osaka has been delayed until 3 p.m. because of the storm, so I won't make it to the two o'clock meeting with Mr. Hughes.
Could you call him and ask if we can move it to Thursday morning? His number is in the client directory.
Also, please print the slides I sent you yesterday and leave them on my desk. I'll look at them when I get back on Wednesday. Thanks!

questions.en: What is probably true about the meeting with Mr. Hughes?
questions.zh: 關於和 Hughes 先生的會議，下列何者可能正確？
options: It will take place at the airport.
It has been moved to 3 p.m.
It is going to be held in Osaka.
It was planned for the same day as the message.

questions.en: What does Ms. Carter want Nina to do with the slides?
questions.zh: Carter 小姐要 Nina 怎麼處理投影片？
options: Send them to Mr. Hughes
Bring them to the airport
Make paper copies of them
Change them before Thursday

passages.title: Help wanted: Warehouse assistant
lines: Harbor Trading is looking for a warehouse assistant to join our team in Keelung.

The job includes packing and labeling orders, counting stock and loading trucks. You must be able to lift boxes of up to 20 kilograms. Experience with inventory software is helpful but not necessary, because we will provide training.
Hours: Monday to Friday, 8 a.m. to 5 p.m. Some Saturdays may be required during busy periods.
To apply, email your resume to Ms. Reed in Human Resources by October 31. No phone calls, please.

questions.en: What is said about inventory software?
questions.zh: 關於庫存軟體，廣告說了什麼？
options: It is used to load the trucks.
People who apply do not need to know how to use it.
Training on it takes place on Saturdays.
The new assistant must install it.

questions.en: How should people apply for the job?
questions.zh: 應徵者應該怎麼應徵這份工作？
options: By sending an email
By calling the warehouse
By visiting the office in Keelung
By coming in on a Saturday

passages.title: Change to your itinerary
lines: Dear Mr. Chen,

We are writing about your trip to Singapore for the Asia Home Products Fair. Because the airline has changed its schedule, your flight on Monday, April 7, will now depart at 2:15 p.m. instead of 9:40 a.m. It will arrive in Singapore at 7:05 p.m. local time.
We have informed your hotel, and your room will be held for you even if you check in late. The airport shuttle to the hotel runs until midnight.

Your return flight on Friday has not changed. An updated itinerary is attached. If the new time is not convenient, please reply by Thursday, and we will try to find you another flight at no extra cost.
Sincerely, Nina Wu (Sky Travel Agency)

questions.en: What is the main purpose of the email?
questions.zh: 這封信的主要目的是什麼？
options: To invite Mr. Chen to a trade fair
To tell a passenger about a new flight time
To confirm a hotel reservation
To offer a cheaper return flight

questions.en: What will most likely happen to Mr. Chen on April 7?
questions.zh: 四月七日陳先生最可能會發生什麼事？
options: He will miss the trade fair.
He must pay for a new ticket.
He has to come back on Thursday.
He will reach his hotel later than he first planned.

questions.en: What should Mr. Chen do if the 2:15 flight does not work for him?
questions.zh: 如果兩點十五分的班機不適合，陳先生應該怎麼做？
options: Write back to the travel agency by Thursday
Call the hotel before he leaves
Take the airport shuttle instead
Change his return flight on Friday

passages.title: Delivery Problem Report
lines: Date: November 18
Customer: Lee's Kitchen Supply (order no. 4512)
Reported by: Leo Park, Warehouse
Items ordered: 12 boxes of glass bowls
Items received: 12 boxes; 3 boxes had broken bowls inside

Details: The customer called on the morning of November 18 to say that three boxes were wet and the bowls inside were broken. These boxes had been loaded onto the truck in the rain and were not wrapped in plastic. They were also not marked "fragile."
Action: Replacement bowls will be sent on November 20. From now on, all fragile goods will be wrapped and labeled before loading.

questions.en: How many boxes arrived in good condition?
questions.zh: 有幾箱送到時完好無損？

questions.en: What most likely caused the problem?
questions.zh: 問題最可能是什麼原因造成的？
options: The customer ordered the wrong bowls.
The goods were not protected from the weather.
The truck arrived on November 20.
The wrong number of boxes was sent.

questions.en: What will the warehouse do from now on?
questions.zh: 倉庫今後會怎麼做？
options: Send all orders on November 20
Stop selling glass bowls
Call customers every morning
Pack glass and other fragile items with more care

passages.title: New system for booking meeting rooms
lines: Starting Monday, March 2, all meeting rooms must be booked on the online calendar. We will no longer use paper booking sheets, so please do not write on the sheet outside Room 5.
You can book a room up to two weeks in advance. If your meeting is canceled, please delete your booking so that other teams can use the room.
Rooms 2 and 3 have projectors. Room 5 is the largest and can hold up to 30 people. For help with the new system, contact Luis in the IT department at extension 214.

questions.en: What is suggested about the sheet outside Room 5?
questions.zh: 關於五號會議室外面的那張表，文中暗示了什麼？
options: Staff used it to book rooms in the past.
It shows which rooms have projectors.
It has space for up to 30 names.
It is updated by Luis every week.

questions.en: What are employees asked to do if a meeting will not take place?
questions.zh: 如果會議不開了，員工被要求做什麼？
options: Call extension 214
Book Room 5 instead
Take it off the calendar
Tell the IT department two weeks before

passages.title: Harbor Trading Family Day
lines: Saturday, September 20, 10 a.m. to 4 p.m., City Park

Bring your family and enjoy a day of outdoor games, music and food! Lunch is served from 12 to 2, and there are vegetarian dishes. The award ceremony for our Employees of the Year starts at 3 p.m. on the main stage.
Please sign up with Ms. Carter by September 12 and tell her how many people are coming. If it rains, the event will move to the banquet hall on the tenth floor of our office building.

questions.en: What happens at 3 p.m.?
questions.zh: 下午三點會有什麼活動？
options: Lunch is served.
The outdoor games begin.
The event moves to the banquet hall.
Some staff members are honored.

questions.en: What is suggested about Family Day?
questions.zh: 關於家庭日，文中暗示了什麼？
options: It is open to employees only.
It may be held inside a building.
It starts with an award ceremony.
It must be paid for by September 12.
